Art direction: match the hand-painted visual identity of Kalistar's Momo illustration electro.png, which has been visually inspected: traditional oil/gouache-like opaque brush planes, expressive sculpted silhouettes, selective fine detail at the face and hands, rich layered color, chipped ancient stone and tactile worn fabric and metal. A lived-in fantasy world, palpable emotion, atmosphere built with confident visible brushwork. The environment tells the story. NOT photorealism, NOT CGI, NOT glossy 3D, NOT anime, NOT a comic panel, NOT generic fantasy promotional splash art. Momo is a STYLE reference only; do not depict Momo, a robot, a flute or a straw hat. Do not copy Momo's seated pose or blue night palette automatically. Keep the central subject humanoid with believable joints, weight, coherent shoulders and pelvis, exactly two attached arms, two attached legs, one head, readable natural hands. No duplicate limbs, no limb-shaped motion trails, no dislocated body, no disconnected hands.
Subject: KAYLIS, beautiful clearly ADULT woman around 24, mixed South Asian and Afro-Caribbean heritage, warm brown skin, fine expressive facial features, dark brown eyes, dark wavy-curly hair tied back loosely. A slim sprinter's build: lean narrow athletic silhouette, strong but not bulky, not a bodybuilder. Practical close-fitting BLACK mine worker clothing, short sleeveless black work top covering the torso, black fitted work trousers, worn sturdy boots, no armor, no cape, no skirt, no cleavage or pin-up styling. Her already awakened RAINBOW tattoos are fine luminous iridescent ornamental flowing lines embedded IN the skin of her arms, seven subtle colors; these are canonical awakened tattoos, not an awakening event and not external rainbow ribbons.
Scene: escaping through the last rising cave passage from the oppressive Z13 mine into the first natural daylight after Gen sacrificed his escape to protect them. A vast rugged canyon and a little distant green vegetation appear beyond the cave mouth. She is alone in the visible frame; companions are out of view. Rough rock walls and dusty rubble tell of the mine. No written runes.
Pose and composition: full figure head to both boots visible with a little breathing room, dynamic forward running stride from dark cave toward the light, viewed from a three-quarter front-side angle. Her forward knee is lifted while the other leg pushes off a stone step. TWO arms only in a simple natural sprint position, one bent forward and the other bent back, both forearms clearly separated from the torso, two visible hands with coherent fingers and thumbs. No touching a third object, no additional reaching arm. Face turns slightly toward the bright exit, not directly at viewer.
Emotion: freedom and fierce determination mixed with the pain of leaving Gen behind; a tear track cuts through dust, jaw set, breath caught, proud adult beauty without glamour posing. Warm dawn grazes her face and black clothing, cooler mineral shadows inside cave, tiny prismatic tattoo light reflects onto the skin without obscuring anatomy. The exit is hope, not a heavenly portal.

Do not redesign any of these.
SINGLE TARGETED FIX: her rear leg is hidden and her run reads as one-legged. Correct ONLY the lower-body running pose and nearby rocks to make EXACTLY TWO attached, separate legs and TWO boots clearly visible at the same time. Retain the foreground bent leg and boot. Make the other leg visibly emerge from the other side of the pelvis with a clearly traceable thigh, bent knee, shin and boot stretching back to the viewer's right, forming a natural sprinter stride in a readable three-quarter side view. The rear boot must be clearly visible to the right of the front shin, silhouetted against lighter rock, not hidden behind the front leg or buried in a rock. Keep pelvis anatomically sound, adult slim proportions and knees facing plausible directions. No additional limb or duplicate boot, no motion ghost, no third arm, no dislocated hip. Head to both boots entirely inside frame, and a little room around the feet. This remains the escape from Z13 in chapter 5 AFTER her Rainbow tattoos have awakened, not a new awakening scene. Output one full-bleed portrait PNG, EXACT 4:5 ratio, ideally 1024 x 1280 pixels or larger exact 4:5. No border, text, logo or watermark.
